verdict.rationale: dlt has a documented, verified CLI (`dlt init`) confirmed by a real runtime probe scaffolding a working pipeline (chess_pipeline.py, secrets template, requirements.txt) headlessly, plus a Python API (`dlt.pipeline().run()`) for programmatic config/run, and an official MCP server (dlt-mcp) that completed a real handshake enabling agent-driven operation. The dltHub AI Harness explicitly documents teaching coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to build and deploy pipelines end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) evidence of an agent autonomously running the full scaffold-configure-run loop end-to-end without any human step.
